title: Operate Air Purifier in Child's Bedroom
description: Run a true HEPA or DIY Corsi-Rosenthal purifier in the bedroom for 8+ hours during sleep.
citation: Nazaroff, W. W. (2004) Indoor particle dynamics; UC Davis Corsi-Rosenthal Box Validation

title: Shift Commute from Two-Wheeler to Metro / AC Train
description: Replace petrol two-wheeler or auto-rickshaw commute with electric mass transit.
citation: Apte et al. (2011) In-vehicle exposure in New Delhi; ARAI Vehicular Emission Factors

title: Seal Windows During Morning Smog Inversion (06:00–10:00)
description: Keep all exterior windows latched during thermal boundary layer trapping hours.

title: Activate Kitchen Chimney / Exhaust During Cooking
description: Operate range hood on high speed while preparing meals with LPG or oil frying.
citation: Huboyo et al. (2014) Indoor air pollution from cooking in urban households

title: Wear Certified N95 / FFP2 Respirator During Commute
description: Wear a snug-fitting NIOSH N95 or ISI-certified FFP2 mask on two-wheeler or walking routes.
citation: US CDC NIOSH Particulate Filter Standards; 3M Technical Bulletin on Roadway PM

title: Shift Outdoor Play and Exercise to Afternoon (13:00–16:00)
description: Reschedule outdoor physical activities to when the atmospheric boundary layer is highest and dispersion is optimal.
citation: SAFAR Diurnal Pollution Dynamics & Boundary Layer Profiling

title: Eliminate Mosquito Coils & Agarbatti Indoors
description: Switch to electric vaporizers, window netting, or essential oil traps instead of smoldering coils.
citation: Liu et al. (2003) Mosquito coil smoke and lung health; ICMR Indoor Air Guidelines

title: Wet Mop Floors Daily; Avoid Dry Broom Sweeping
description: Dry sweeping with a broom resuspends settled PM10 and PM2.5 back into breathable air.
citation: US EPA Indoor Air Quality Guidelines for Dust & Allergens
